results.content: Nearly half of registered voters believe the Supreme Court is biased in favor of President Donald Trump, according to a new Economist/YouGov poll, as Trump has increasingly sought the justices' intervention on election-related matters ahead of the midterms. The poll, conducted September 4-8 among 1,469 registered voters, found that 44 percent said the Supreme Court is biased in favor of Trump, while just 12 percent said it is biased against him. Among Democrats, 77 percent said the Court favors Trump, while 20 percent of Republicans said it is biased against him and nearly 50 percent said it treats him fairly.
